comment: Expected kernel command line of a production release on the bootm path, per slot. scripts/check-release-cmdline.py compares it with components.slots.*.cmdline of pcr-reference-rock5a.json, which mk-pcr-reference.py reads from /chosen bootargs of each slot's devicetree inside the signed FIT. The dm-mod.create table is checked by form, because its sizes, root hash and salt change with every build; every other word is compared exactly and in order. A change here is a change to what the device boots and goes through review like one.
